problem.label: The problem
problem.body: Holding attention comes down to small decisions: the opening line, the pauses to cut, the graphic that actually helps. Most editors skip these decisions.

points.title: The hook is buried

points.title: Busy, not clear
points.body: Random zooms and emojis everywhere, but nothing on screen helps your point land.

points.title: Round five of revisions
points.body: Every change means redoing work, so one reel drags on for a week.
